footnote_text: The Reporting Person exercised stock options and used a portion of the shares to pay the option exercise price and cover tax withholding obligations via a net exercise by electing to have the Issuer withhold shares otherwise deliverable after the stock option exercise. Represents the number of shares withheld by the Issuer to satisfy the exercise price and tax withholding obligations in connection with the net settlement of the stock options.
